source: Read-only evaluation audit; original source anchors verified by the evaluation reviewer

findings.title: Macro RMSE averaged errors before squaring
findings.finding: Original macro-side summaries computed RMS of window-mean errors, not fast-tick RMSE; partial windows were equally weighted. The separate hardware summary already aggregated per-tick environment-reported error. Missing producing records prevent proving which column supplied the archived Table 1.
findings.disposition: Fixed physical-mode aggregation uses tracking_error_sq_sum/sub_steps_run. Do not claim signed-error cancellation if the source error is absolute.

findings.title: First BESS aging increment omitted
findings.finding: Aging was final_age minus the first post-step age, rather than reset age, multiplied by 10000. It is the simulator's aging fraction, not battery-throughput MWh.
findings.disposition: Still present in the generic runner. The new separate Table 1 collector must use reset-to-service-end aging.

findings.title: No-inner row lacked fast metric collection
findings.finding: The generic benchmark installed the fast instrumentation only when an inner controller existed, leaving no-hardware low reward, warning and aging uncollected.
findings.disposition: Still present in the generic runner. A new explicit fixed-setpoint callback can collect the same physical fields without changing the plant.

findings.title: Hardware SD field names contain an extra underscore
findings.finding: Output keys such as tracking_rmse__std use two underscores, so consumers expecting _std can miss hardware SDs.
findings.disposition: Still present in the generic exporter; the new study uses explicit metric/SD keys.

findings.title: Random-controller action RNG was not an episode-seeded stream
findings.finding: Global Python/NumPy/Torch seeding does not seed a Gym action space. The sampled action space belongs to a seed-0 construction environment, not each evaluated episode.
findings.disposition: Physical resets seed action spaces, but the generic construction-space stream is still not an independent per-episode policy stream. The new study seeds its case-local random controller explicitly.

findings.title: Stateful classical controllers carried state across episodes
findings.finding: The original generic runner reused controllers without reset. PID integrators and bang-bang hysteresis can therefore carry prior-episode state into another seed.
findings.disposition: Current runner resets controllers exposing reset(); bang-bang has no reset method. The new study constructs fresh controllers per case.

findings.title: Macro survival counted calls, not successful fast completion
findings.finding: Termination during the last macro call can still satisfy the macro-call count. Full survival requires all fast ticks and no physical termination.
findings.disposition: Still present in the generic runner. It does not prove that the archived 100% survival claim was wrong; original raw episodes are unavailable.

findings.title: PPO normalization restoration was not fail-closed
findings.finding: An absent normalization pickle could leave PPO unnormalized; the original restore constructed a fast environment even for a macro PPO policy.
findings.disposition: Corrected loader chooses the appropriate environment class. No original-bidding PPO artifact was found for this requested rerun; economic fractional PPO is not a substitute.

findings.title: LLM warm-up filtering changes the requested cohort
findings.finding: Warm-up filtering can remove evaluation episodes while the reported requested count stays unchanged; excessive skipping falls back to all episodes.
findings.disposition: Do not use this behavior to construct a matched five-case table. No LLM row is run in the authorized seven-row study.

findings.title: Table 2's legacy calendar shim is not timestamp-faithful
findings.finding: Repeating each NYC source row sixty times assumes exact five-minute intervals. The selected peak dates contain 302/299/294 valid rows, and their first 288 rows end at 22:45/23:00/23:30. Workload phase remained zero, and bias was patched after the reset observation.
findings.disposition: Physical-mode replay uses actual timestamps, advances workload start day, and applies bias before reset. This particular shim belongs to Table 2, not the nominal Table 1 runner.

findings.title: Table 2 prefix comparisons concealed incomplete horizons
findings.finding: The original evaluator used a common available prefix and recomputed stress quantiles on that prefix, while revenue remained an episode total.
findings.disposition: Physical-mode evaluation rejects incomplete matched comparisons and suppresses incomplete aggregate estimates. Do not infer this altered Table 1 if all its runs completed.

findings.title: Thermal-warning boundary conventions differ
findings.finding: The benchmark uses normalized observations with >=33 C; the callback uses actual info temperatures with >33 C. A fraction of warning ticks is not the fraction of episodes with any warning.
findings.disposition: Still distinct. The new study explicitly records its actual-temperature boundary and both interpretations where available.

findings.title: Original Table 1 provenance is incomplete
findings.finding: No original Table 1 episode manifests, exact command, matching full result CSV, PPO weights/normalizer, or LLM execution receipt was recovered. Older summary CSVs do not match the published 229 +/-18 kW. Original README says macro SAC 780 +/-26, whereas camera_ready.tex says 780 +/-626.
findings.disposition: The discrepancy cannot be adjudicated without producing records. New results must be labelled a corrected Table 1-style comparison, not an exact reproduction of all archival numbers.

not_findings: Source uses sample SD with ddof=1, not population SD.
No silent SAC-to-PPO or rule-controller checkpoint substitution was found.
The specialized SAC-high/SAC-low runner alone lacks all Table 1 columns.
